item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM([{'answer': 'Paris'}, ...], adapter=dspy.JSONAdapter())` under an outer `dspy.ChatAdapter()`, creating the JSON-vs-chat-format mismatch."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Shows `with dspy.context(..., adapter=dspy.ChatAdapter()): out = prog(...)` succeeds and asserts `out.answer == 'Paris'`, matching transparent fallback behavior."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Explicitly proves the retry by asserting `len(lm1.history) == 2` and printing the fallback call count."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `dspy.ChatAdapter(use_json_adapter_fallback=False)` for the second run, which is the no-fallback configuration requested."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Wraps the no-fallback run in `pytest`-style logic and catches `AdapterParseError`, with an assertion that failure must occur instead of success."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
